head: DT-275
origin: player report 11-11 (preview.22: 'almost no mobs, esp. around Elven Village; none around Batoh'); datapack count 11-11
what: fields look empty to the player: (a) around Batoh (31884,80876) the datapack has no monster within 3000, a data fact; (b) at 45868,34914 the datapack expects ~15 monsters within 3000 (~5 within 1500) yet a hot bot's status showed none within 1500 for 5 minutes: unknown whether bots outkill the 20 s respawn, monsters are lost at runtime, or the density itself is below C4 (cause NOT known: investigation)
fix: investigation: live alive-monster count against boot; datapack density against a second C4 reference (Lisvus spawnlist); kills against respawn output on newbie fields in a saved run

closed.reason: not a bug: the datapack is C4's (Lisvus and Mobius agree; the C3 patch removed the Lake Iris monsters; l2hub's C4 list matches); no runtime loss on the saved run; what empties a field is hunters over its respawn, row 1b.4 (DT-121)

head: DT-385
sites: Npc.js chase pathFailed (npcHate noPath), ATTACK_TIMEOUT_MS; GeodataEngine.hasLineOfSight height ray
what: since sight is the height ray, hot mobs that see a body they cannot walk to stand in combat asking routes on backoff: noPath 189 vs 16, attack timeouts 5 vs 0 in a 20-min hot run → a mob that aggroed over a skirt stands in place up to 2 min, then goes home
fix: trace the chase drop with npc, target and spot to size the pairs; keep as C4 (F7) or let a mob that cannot reach drop the target sooner, with its C4 source

closed.reason: accepted as C4: Lisvus has only the 120 s attack timeout for a mob that cannot reach its target (Npc.js:32 comment); sight over a skirt is the C4 height ray

head: DT-475
what: No NPC buy list holds a C-grade weapon or armour piece: of 537 item ids the lists can emit, ranks are d 120, none 155, non-gear 262, c/b/a/s 0, while the item data has 407 C items; Giran, Oren, Aden and Hunter's Village weapon and armour NPCs (7084, 7088, 7178, 7179, 7684, 7230, 7837, 7838) are bound and spawned but reuse D-or-lower base lists (the file header says the lists were seeded from C2 pages) → a level 40+ character has no NPC source of C gear; with no D crystals on sale the Luxury exchange is unreachable too, so a fresh world wears D to level 52+ (economy model, x10 40 h: 96 C pieces against 9086 D)
fix: add the C4 NPC C-grade rows to the Giran, Oren, Aden and Hunter's Village weapon and armour lists from a named C4 source (which pieces each shop sold in C4 is to be verified, not taken from memory); rebuild the bot tables

closed.reason: refuted by the project's data reference: l2hub.info C4 sell lists of the ten weapon and armour traders of Giran, Oren, Aden and Hunter's Village top out at D (top items' grade d on their item pages); C gear in C4 comes from the Giran Luxury exchange for crystals, craft and drops. The game's lists follow C4; Goddard, Rune, Heine, Dion not checked
